narrative: Got a call that half the string inverters over in B06 had gone offline overnight, so I went ahead and drove out first thing to have a look. By the time I got there every one of them was back up and reporting normally, nothing to do. It had been a very humid night, the fog was still sitting in the low ground when I came through the gate, and these do seem to do it when it is like that. No production loss at all, they were inverting the whole time as far as the meter is concerned, it is just the reporting that drops.
